title: Sentinel detection rule
description: A Microsoft Sentinel scheduled analytics rule stored as YAML. Each file converts to one Microsoft.SecurityInsights/alertRules resource with kind 'Scheduled'.
$comment: Validates structure only. Value ranges ARM enforces (for example duration limits) and entity/identifier combinations are checked by the converter, not here.

allOf.$comment: Suppression needs a duration when it is turned on.

id.description: Stable GUID for the rule. Maps to the alert rule's ARM resource name. Never change it after creation, or Sentinel treats the rule as a new one.

name.description: Human-readable rule name shown in Sentinel. Maps to ARM properties.displayName.

description.description: What the rule detects and why it matters. Maps to ARM properties.description.

severity.description: Alert severity. Maps to ARM properties.severity.

queryFrequency.description: How often the query runs, as a short duration such as 5m, 1h or 1d. The converter turns it into ISO 8601 (for example PT5M) for ARM properties.queryFrequency.
queryFrequency.$comment: The allowed range is checked by the converter.

queryPeriod.description: How far back each run looks, as a short duration such as 5m, 1h or 1d. The converter turns it into ISO 8601 for ARM properties.queryPeriod.
queryPeriod.$comment: The allowed range is checked by the converter.

triggerOperator.description: Comparison applied to the query's result count. The converter maps gt/lt/eq/ne to GreaterThan/LessThan/Equal/NotEqual for ARM properties.triggerOperator.

triggerThreshold.description: Result count compared against triggerOperator to decide whether to fire an alert. Maps to ARM properties.triggerThreshold.

tactics.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactics the rule covers, in ARM spelling (no spaces). Maps to ARM properties.tactics.

relevantTechniques.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique and sub-technique IDs, such as T1059 or T1059.001. Feeds ARM properties.techniques and properties.subTechniques.
relevantTechniques.$comment: The converter splits this list: parent IDs go to ARM techniques, sub-technique IDs go to subTechniques.

query.description: The KQL detection query. Maps to ARM properties.query.

entityMappings.description: Maps query output columns to Sentinel entities. Maps to ARM properties.entityMappings.
entityMappings.$comment: Whether an identifier is valid for its entityType is not checked here.

items.description: One entity mapping. Maps to one element of ARM properties.entityMappings.

entityType.description: Sentinel entity type. Maps to ARM entityMappings[].entityType.

fieldMappings.description: Identifier-to-column pairs for this entity. Maps to ARM entityMappings[].fieldMappings.

identifier.description: Entity identifier, such as FullName or HostName. Maps to ARM fieldMappings[].identifier.

columnName.description: Query output column that supplies the identifier's value. Maps to ARM fieldMappings[].columnName.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is active after deployment. Maps to ARM properties.enabled.
enabled.$comment: The converter defaults this to true when omitted.

version.description: Semantic version of the rule (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Project metadata only; not sent to ARM.

suppressionEnabled.description: Whether to stop the rule running for suppressionDuration after it fires. Maps to ARM properties.suppressionEnabled.
suppressionEnabled.$comment: The converter defaults this to false when omitted.

suppressionDuration.description: How long to suppress the rule after it fires, as a short duration such as 5m, 1h or 1d. The converter turns it into ISO 8601 for ARM properties.suppressionDuration.
suppressionDuration.$comment: The allowed range is checked by the converter.

incidentConfiguration.description: How alerts from this rule become incidents. Maps to ARM properties.incidentConfiguration.
incidentConfiguration.$comment: The converter supplies defaults when this or any of its fields are omitted.

createIncident.description: Whether alerts from this rule create incidents. Maps to ARM incidentConfiguration.createIncident.

groupingConfiguration.description: How related alerts are grouped into one incident. Maps to ARM incidentConfiguration.groupingConfiguration.
groupingConfiguration.$comment: Selected grouping needs at least one entity in groupByEntities.

enabled.description: Whether alert grouping is on. Maps to ARM groupingConfiguration.enabled.

reopenClosedIncident.description: Whether a matching alert reopens a closed incident. Maps to ARM groupingConfiguration.reopenClosedIncident.

lookbackDuration.description: Time window for grouping alerts, as a short duration such as 5m, 1h or 1d. The converter turns it into ISO 8601 for ARM groupingConfiguration.lookbackDuration.
lookbackDuration.$comment: The allowed range is checked by the converter.

matchingMethod.description: How alerts are matched for grouping. Maps to ARM groupingConfiguration.matchingMethod.

groupByEntities.description: Entity types to group by when matchingMethod is Selected. Maps to ARM groupingConfiguration.groupByEntities.
